StreamInfo.title: StreamInfo
StreamInfo.description: Deterministic per-stream projection: tenant scope, first/last sequence (the cursor), and event count.

EventStreamId.title: EventStreamId
EventStreamId.description: Opaque event stream identity: the unit of total order; every event in a stream carries a contiguous 1-based sequence.

EventTenantId.title: EventTenantId
EventTenantId.description: Opaque tenant scope of an event: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

EventSequence.title: EventSequence
EventSequence.description: One event sequence number: 1-based, strictly contiguous per stream (the stream cursor).
